db:info.db:title: FullyDocumented Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <typename T, typename Allocator> class FullyDocumented

db:abstract.db:para: A template class with all parameters documented.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: T is the element type stored in the container. Allocator is the allocator type used for memory management.

db:section.db:title: void FullyDocumented::add(T value)
db:section.db:para: Adds value to the container. The type T determines how the value is stored.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> void templateFunc(T value)
db:section.db:para: A template function that takes value of type T.
